mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS dispatchId, d.task_id AS dispatchPlanId, t.task_name AS planName, d.task_name AS taskName, d.task_desc AS taskDesc, d.template_id AS templateId, d.period_no AS periodNo, d.period_name AS periodName, d.manual_flag AS manualFlag, d.start_time AS startTime, d.end_time AS endTime, CASE WHEN IFNULL(c.urge_days, 0) > 0 THEN DATE_SUB(d.end_time, INTERVAL c.urge_days DAY) ELSE NULL END AS urgeTime, d.create_time AS dispatchTime, d.id AS primaryTaskId, COALESCE(m.memberCount, 0) AS memberCount, COALESCE(m.runningCount, 0) AS runningCount, COALESCE(m.finishedCount, 0) AS finishedCount, COALESCE(m.cancelledCount, 0) AS cancelledCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.runningCount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(m.memberCount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(m.cancelledCount, 0) = COALESCE(m.memberCount, 0) THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status FROM flow_task_dispatch d LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch t ON t.id = d.task_id LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch_config c ON c.task_id = d.task_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dispatch_id, COUNT(*) AS memberCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount FROM flow_task GROUP BY dispatch_id ) m ON m.dispatch_id = d.id
